```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("../../config/paths.R")

experiment_name <- "gt_100taxa_high_signal"
beast_run_name <- "dynamic_sequence_gt"

paths <- make_run_paths(experiment_name)

sim_data_path <- file.path(
  paths$sim_data_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_sim_data.rds")
)

beast_output_dir <- paths$beast_output_dir
tables_dir <- paths$tables_dir

  beast_output_dir,
  paste0("latest_workflow_config_", beast_run_name, ".rds")
)
```

# Purpose

This file summarises the standard BEAST trace log produced by the current XML run.


# Load run metadata and simulation truth

```{r load-inputs}
if (!file.exists(sim_data_path)) {
  stop("Simulation data not found. Run 01_simulate_data.Rmd first: ", sim_data_path)
}

if (!file.exists(workflow_config_path)) {
  stop("Workflow config not found. Run 02_generate_xml.Rmd first: ", workflow_config_path)
}

sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)
workflow_config <- readRDS(workflow_config_path)

beast_log_path <- workflow_config$beast_log_path

if (!is.null(workflow_config$experiment_name)) {
  experiment_name <- workflow_config$experiment_name
}

if (!is.null(workflow_config$beast_run_name)) {
  beast_run_name <- workflow_config$beast_run_name
} else {
  beast_run_name <- workflow_config$run_name
}

if (!file.exists(beast_log_path)) {
  stop(
    "BEAST trace log not found: ", beast_log_path,
    "\nRun the XML generated by 02_generate_xml.Rmd first."
  )
}

true_values <- sim_data$true_values
true_values
cat("\nBEAST log path:\n", beast_log_path, "\n")

cat("\nBEAST log file info:\n")
print(file.info(beast_log_path)[, c("size", "mtime")])
```

# Settings

```{r settings}
burnin_fraction <- (3/13)

parameter_truth_map <- c(
  beta = "intercept",
  brownianVariance = "v_phylo",

```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
read_beast_log <- function(path) {

  raw_lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)

  table_lines <- raw_lines[!grepl("^\\s*#", raw_lines)]
  table_lines <- table_lines[nzchar(trimws(table_lines))]

  if (length(table_lines) == 0) {
    stop("No tabular lines found in BEAST log: ", path)
  }

  read.table(
    text = paste(table_lines, collapse = "\n"),
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

estimate_ess <- function(x, max_lag = NULL) {

  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)

  if (n < 3 || stats::var(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  if (is.null(max_lag)) {
    max_lag <- min(n - 1, 1000)
  }

  acf_values <- as.numeric(stats::acf(
    x,
    lag.max = max_lag,
    plot = FALSE,
    na.action = na.pass
  )$acf)[-1]

  # Initial-positive-sequence style truncation.
  negative_at <- which(acf_values < 0)[1]
  if (!is.na(negative_at)) {
    acf_values <- acf_values[seq_len(max(negative_at - 1, 0))]
  }

  if (length(acf_values) == 0) {
    return(n)
  }

  n / (1 + 2 * sum(acf_values))
}

summarise_trace_column <- function(x) {

  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  c(
    n = length(x),
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = stats::sd(x),
    median = stats::median(x),
    q025 = unname(stats::quantile(x, 0.025)),
    q975 = unname(stats::quantile(x, 0.975)),
    ess = estimate_ess(x)
  )
}

get_true_value <- function(parameter, true_values, parameter_truth_map) {

  if (!parameter %in% names(parameter_truth_map)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  truth_name <- unname(parameter_truth_map[[parameter]])
  match_index <- match(truth_name, true_values$parameter)

  if (is.na(match_index)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  true_values$value[match_index]
}
```

# Read and summarise posterior trace

```{r summarise-posterior}
beast_log <- read_beast_log(beast_log_path)

cat("Columns in BEAST log:\n")
print(names(beast_log))

if (!"Sample" %in% names(beast_log)) {
  stop("Expected a BEAST 'Sample' column in the log file.")
}

n_rows <- nrow(beast_log)
burnin_rows <- floor(burnin_fraction * n_rows)

posterior_trace <- beast_log[seq.int(burnin_rows + 1, n_rows), , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nTrace rows:", n_rows, "\n")
cat("Burn-in fraction:", burnin_fraction, "\n")
cat("Burn-in rows removed:", burnin_rows, "\n")
cat("Posterior rows retained:", nrow(posterior_trace), "\n")

excluded_columns <- c("Sample")
summary_columns <- setdiff(names(posterior_trace), excluded_columns)

# Keep only numeric columns
numeric_summary_columns <- summary_columns[vapply(
  posterior_trace[summary_columns],
  is.numeric,
  logical(1)
)]

posterior_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(numeric_summary_columns, function(parameter) {

    stats <- summarise_trace_column(posterior_trace[[parameter]])
    true_value <- get_true_value(parameter, true_values, parameter_truth_map)

    data.frame(
      experiment_name = experiment_name,
      beast_run_name = beast_run_name,
      parameter = parameter,
      n = unname(stats["n"]),
      mean = unname(stats["mean"]),
      sd = unname(stats["sd"]),
      median = unname(stats["median"]),
      q025 = unname(stats["q025"]),
      q975 = unname(stats["q975"]),
      ess = unname(stats["ess"]),
      true_parameter = if (parameter %in% names(parameter_truth_map)) {
        unname(parameter_truth_map[[parameter]])
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      true_value = true_value,
      mean_minus_true = if (is.finite(true_value)) {
        unname(stats["mean"]) - true_value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      true_inside_95_interval = if (is.finite(true_value)) {
        true_value >= unname(stats["q025"]) && true_value <= unname(stats["q975"])
      } else {
        NA
      },
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

posterior_summary
```

# Posterior trace diagnostics

```{r trace-diags}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

diagnostic_parameters <- c(
  "posterior",
  "beta",
  "brownianVariance",
  "residualVariance"
)

posterior_diagnostics_long <- posterior_trace %>%
  select(Sample, all_of(diagnostic_parameters)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diagnostic_parameters),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Trace plots
ggplot(
  posterior_diagnostics_long,
  aes(x = Sample, y = value)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior trace diagnostics",
    x = "Post-burn-in sample",
    y = "Value"
  )

# Marginal posterior densities
ggplot(
  posterior_diagnostics_long,
  aes(x = value)
) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior marginal densities",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Density"
  )

# Autocorrelation plots
posterior_acf_df <- lapply(
  diagnostic_parameters,
  function(parameter) {

    acf_object <- acf(
      posterior_trace[[parameter]],
      plot = FALSE,
      lag.max = 100
    )

    data.frame(
      parameter = parameter,
      lag = as.numeric(acf_object$lag),
      acf = as.numeric(acf_object$acf)
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

ggplot(
  posterior_acf_df,
  aes(x = lag, y = acf)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior autocorrelation",
    x = "Lag",
    y = "Autocorrelation"
  )
```
